settings.heading: Why include CoQ10?
settings.row_content:
Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10) is a naturally occurring substance that plays a vital role in energy production. It is found in every cell in the body, but it is especially concentrated in the heart, brain, and muscles. CoQ10 helps to produce adenosine triphosphate (ATP), which is the body's main source of energy.

As we age, our production of CoQ10 naturally declines. This can lead to a number of health problems, including fatigue, muscle weakness, and heart disease.* CoQ10 supplements can help to improve energy levels, reduce muscle pain, and protect the heart.

In addition to its benefits for energy production and heart health, CoQ10 has also been shown to:

  • Reduce blood pressure*
  • Improve blood sugar control*

If you are looking for a natural way to improve your energy levels, heart health, and overall well-being, CoQ10 is a great option. Orenda Active is a high-quality CoQ10 supplement that is made with all-natural ingredients.

settings.heading: Why include Alpha-lipoic acid (ALA)?
settings.row_content:
Alpha-lipoic acid (ALA) is a naturally occurring compound that functions as a coenzyme in the body. It is both water-soluble and fat-soluble, allowing it to work in various parts of cells and tissues. ALA has been studied for its potential health benefits, including:

Antioxidant activity: ALA is a powerful antioxidant that can help protect cells from damage caused by free radicals.*

Blood sugar control: ALA may help improve blood sugar levels and how the body responds to insulin.*

Brain health: ALA may help protect brain cells from damage and may improve cognitive function.*

Cardiovascular health: ALA may help improve heart health by lowering blood pressure, improving cholesterol levels, and supporting the function of blood vessels.

Weight management: ALA may help with weight loss and metabolic function.*

It is important to note that these are just some of the potential health benefits of ALA.

settings.heading: Why include N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine (NAC)?
settings.row_content:
N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine (NAC) is a powerful antioxidant that can help protect your body from damage caused by free radicals. It is also a precursor to glutathione, which is another important antioxidant. NAC has been shown to have a number of health benefits, including:

Improved respiratory health: NAC can help to break up mucus in the lungs, which can make it easier to cough it up. It can also help to reduce inflammation in the lungs, which can make it easier to breathe.

Improved heart health: NAC can help lower blood pressure and improve cholesterol levels. It may also help support heart health by reducing inflammation and oxidative stress.

  • Improved immune function: NAC is a supplement that is made from the amino acid cysteine. It has been shown to have a number of health benefits, including improving immune function. NAC can help to increase the production of white blood cells, which are important for fighting off infection. It can also help to reduce inflammation, which can help the body to heal from infection.
  • NAC may help improve athletic performance: NAC may help improve athletic performance by increasing oxygen delivery to the muscles and reducing inflammation.

settings.heading: Why include Resveratrol?
settings.row_content:
Resveratrol is a polyphenol found in the skin of grapes, red wine, and other fruits and vegetables. It has been shown to have a number of health benefits, including:

Antioxidant activity: Resveratrol can help protect cells from damage caused by free radicals.

  • Anti-inflammatory activity: Resveratrol can help reduce inflammation, which is a major factor in many chronic diseases.
  • Cardiovascular health: Resveratrol can help improve heart health by reducing cholesterol levels, blood pressure, and inflammation.
  • Brain health: Resveratrol may help improve brain health.

settings.heading: What's in the Young & Active Herbal Blend?
settings.row_content:
Prickly pear and asparagus extract are two natural sources of heat shock proteins (HSPs). HSPs are a family of proteins that are produced by cells in response to stress. HSPs help to protect cells from damage and to repair damaged cells, which may help to reduce the risk of a variety of health problems.

Specifically, HSPs have been shown to:

  • Improve heart health by reducing inflammation and oxidative stress
  • Reduce muscle damage caused by exercise

settings.heading: Why does Orenda's Oki Chocolate use 70% Cacao?
settings.row_content:
We chose 70% cacao for a blend of delicious taste and beneficial properties. Here's why it matters:

Rich in Beneficial Compounds: Cacao, especially at higher percentages like 70%, is loaded with flavanols, polyphenols, and flavonoids. These are powerful antioxidants. Compounds like catechin, epicatechin, and procyanidins are known for their antioxidant activity, helping to support your body in neutralizing free radicals and preventing oxidative stress.*

Mood-Enhancing Qualities: Dark chocolate is more than just a treat; it's a mood booster. The polyphenols in cacao can lower cortisol, a stress hormone, offering you a natural way to uplift your mood.*

Support for Healthy Blood Pressure: High-cacao dark chocolate has been linked to supporting healthy blood pressure levels.* This benefit is tied to the natural compounds found in cacao that help in promoting cardiovascular health.

Anti-Inflammatory Properties: The compounds in 70% cacao dark chocolate may also contribute to reducing inflammation in the body.* This can be particularly beneficial for joint health, offering a delicious way to support your body's natural well-being.

A Perfect Balance: We've found that 70% cacao strikes the perfect balance between the rich, bold flavor of dark chocolate and these health-supporting attributes. It's our sweet spot for delivering a chocolate that's both indulgent and beneficial.

So, when you savor a piece of Oki Chocolate, you're not just enjoying a luxurious treat; you're also embracing the myriad of benefits that 70% cacao brings to your overall well-being. Enjoy your journey to health and happiness, one delicious nibble at a time!

settings.heading: Why use non-alkalized Cacao?
settings.row_content:
Why use non-alkalized Cacao?

Using non-alkalized cacao is a crucial part of Oki Chocolate's commitment to quality and health benefits. Here’s the scoop:

Preserving Flavanols: Natural cocoa is rich in flavanols, which are natural compounds with beneficial properties. However, when cocoa is processed with alkali, a method known as Dutch processing, or “Dutching”, these flavanols are significantly reduced. By choosing non-alkalized cacao, Oki Chocolate ensures that these valuable flavanols are preserved.

The Process Matters: Non-alkalized cocoa powder is made from cocoa beans that are simply roasted and ground, maintaining the integrity of the cocoa. This contrasts with Dutch-process cocoa, where beans are treated with an alkaline solution, which, while reducing bitterness, also decreases the flavanol content.

Supporting Heart Health: Research indicates that specific flavanols like epicatechin found abundantly in non-alkalized cacao, are particularly beneficial for heart health. These compounds are more prevalent in natural cocoa compared to their alkalized counterparts.

Natural Taste and Benefits: By using non-alkalized cacao, Oki Chocolate not only delivers a richer, more authentic chocolate flavor but also ensures that the chocolate retains its natural, health-supporting properties.

So, when you enjoy Oki Chocolate, you're not just indulging in a decadent treat, but you're also benefiting from the full, natural goodness of cocoa. It's our way of ensuring every nibble is as nourishing as it is delightful.
